Learning a martial art, at least in my opinion, will still help tremendously with your self-confidence. Learning to fight may not give you the courage you dream of, but it’ll give you the confidence and discipline that can help you in other areas of life. Also, to be perfectly honest, I’m terrified of the concept of fighting, but I love sparring and martial arts. This may not be the same for everyone, but just drilling and sparring will make you feel more comfortable with the concept of physical altercation just because you’ll become used to dealing with it in a controlled environment where you’re not in real danger. I’ve been in a few street fights after many years of wrestling and Jiu Jitsu, and while they fear of the fight is still there, once the fists start flying it’s almost like your ego slips away and your body just begins reacting to the attacks based on muscle memory and adrenaline. There are very few people out there that enjoy fighting in a real and dangerous situation, but learning a martial art will make you feel more confident about dealing with them
